summary: This report provides an update on the Gerrard-Carlaw Planning Study. It provides information on revised Provincial policies and transit plans, and the impact that these changes in Provincial direction will have on the Study scope, direction and timelines. This report also includes a revised Terms of Reference.
decided: City Council on December 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (November 14, 2019) from the Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District for information. 2. City Council revise the terms of reference for the Gerrard Carlaw Planning Study to include provisions for affordable housing as a requirement for new development.
text: This report provides an update on the Gerrard-Carlaw Planning Study. It provides information on revised Provincial policies and transit plans, and the impact that these changes in Provincial direction will have on the Study scope, direction and timelines. This report also includes a revised Terms of Reference.

City Council on December 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (November 14, 2019) from the Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District for information. 2. City Council revise the terms of reference for the Gerrard Carlaw Planning Study to include provisions for affordable housing as a requirement for new development.
